A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the local zeta-integral for GSp(2) x GSp(2), which is the product of two local L-factors, is compatible with the Langlands correspondence for both factors.
we give a complete proof of the local Langlands conjectures for GSp(3) and GSp4 in the case when the GL(1) component of the L-packet is the trivial character.
we have completed the local zeta-integral computation for the GSp(6) L-function, and have made progress on the local zeta integral computation for the GSO(8) L-function.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the poles of the GSO L-factors for GSp(2n) x GL(n), n > 1, are in bijection with the poles of the L-factors for GL(2n) studied by Rallis and Schiffmann.
these poles are not exceptional at all, but rather are expected to be the only poles of the corresponding L-functions.
